plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Management Information Science Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published June 08, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7641/PublishedPdf). Certificate of Achievement (grade of C or better in each course). Official Total Units: 35-39; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path at the low end of the variable-unit ranges = 14+12+9 = 35 units (both Major Elective (1) slots at 2 units; both Major Elective (2) slots at 3 units). Semester sums verified against the map's 14 / 12-15 / 9-10 headers. Major Elective (1) requirement: a minimum of 4 units TOTAL across Semester 2 (choose 1 course) and Semester 3 (choose 1-2 courses not already completed) from CISA 306 (2), CISA 316 (2), CISC 324 (1), CISC 355 (1.5), CISC 360 (3), CISP 350 (4). CISC 360 is typically only offered during the fall semester. Major Elective (2) requirement: a minimum of 6 units TOTAL across Semester 2 (choose 1 course) and Semester 3 (choose 1 course not already completed) from CISC 355 (1.5), CISD 357/CISP 357 (4), CISD 358/CISP 358 (4), CISN 300 (3), CISN 303 (3), CISN 306 (3), CISN 308 (3), CISP 310 (4), CISP 350 (3), CISP 400 (4), CISP 401 (4), CISP 430 (4), CISP 440 (3), CISP 457 (3), CISS 300 (1), CISS 310 (3), CISS 315 (3), CISW 327 (4), CISW 400 (4), CISW 410 (4). Semester-offering notes: CISN 303, CISN 306, CISN 308, CISP 430, CISW 410 typically spring only; CISP 457, CISW 400 typically fall only. Many elective courses have prerequisites; review course requirements or consult a counselor before enrolling. Sequencing prereqs per map: CISA 323 requires CISC 300 or 310; CISP 360 requires CISP 301; CISA 305 requires CISC 300 or 310; CISC 305 requires CISC 300, 310, or 320; CISP 400 & 401 require CISP 360. (CISC 300 is listed in external_prereqs as an accepted prerequisite alternative not in this plan.) tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
